csv_project_name: AE Services for RTC Building 5026 Remodel
csv_scope_of_work: OMD is seeking an Architect ( Consultant ) to provide architectural design services for the RTC Building 5026 Remodel Project. Building 5026 is an approximate 5026 square foot stick-built frame structure with composition roof on wood sheeting and wood trusses. Standard sheetrock finishes on the interior with wood exterior sheeting and asbestos siding built in 1942. The building currently houses the Billeting and Lodging Welcome Center and Reese Range Control. .Building 5026 is situated on Cedar Street, approximately .10 miles north of the main gate The RTC Building 5026 Remodel Project will be delivered in one construction package and includes the following: Project Criteria 41240040 Replace the existing HVAC of Building 5026 (FACNO 00032) at Rees Training Center (RTC) in order to add capability. This work is considered repair under the Sustainment program and will be of permanent construction to extend the usable life of the facility. The Work under this criteria includes the demolition of several old HVAC systems, the installation of a new HVAC system, and repair any additional items related to the HVAC due to deferred maintenance. The HVAC for the facility must be designed to meet Industry Standards as well as all local and State building codes. Project Criteria 41260021 Asbestos abatement, disposal and replacement of existing siding. The continuous insulation under the existing vinyl siding will be removed and replaced. A new building wrap vapor barrier will be installed on the walls before new siding is installed. Replacement of degraded windows to improve energy conservation. Painting of the exterior to match Cantonment scheme, Repair/replacement of both existing roofs on the building. The TPO roof has failed in several areas and has created structural issues which need repaired prior to new roof installation. The composite roof has duct penetrations that need to be sealed and repaired prior to new roof installation. Roof replacement to be metal roofing system to extend usable life exceeding another 25 years.
